name: Ribeye Steak with Orange, Ginger & Kale Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil and position a rack under the broiler; position a second rack in the bottom portion of the oven and place a baking sheet on it to preheat.
While the oven heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce (skip the broccoli slaw if it came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 oranges
3 (340 g) pkgs broccoli slaw
1 ½ bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or grate the ginger; place in a medium salad bowl and add peanut butter, chili garlic sauce, honey, and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp natural peanut butter
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Juice oranges into the salad bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.

Carefully remove the baking sheet from the oven and use tongs to transfer steak onto it. Place under broiler on top rack and cook 6-7 minutes for medium rare, flipping once halfway through. Transfer steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the salad bowl; add broccoli slaw.
Drizzle any pan juices over the salad and toss with salad dressing to combine.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls along with steak strips. Enjoy!
